segments.title: Cold Open & Reverse Hype Train
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the cold open as Papito; Hype Train hijacks the feed for a backwards freestyle rap session, thanking subscribers in reverse and debating reversed-word semantics with Case.

segments.title: Gaza Starvation, Starmer's Ultimatum, and the Slotkin Interview
segments.notes: Case and Rick cover Trump's Gaza food-center pledge, Starmer's conditional Palestinian recognition, and the Breaking Points interview where Melissa Slotkin refuses to commit to cutting military aid to Israel.

segments.title: Trump's Epstein Spa Defense
segments.notes: Case and Rick dissect Trump's claim that his falling out with Epstein was over stolen spa employees, including Virginia Giuffre, and his assertion that he never had the 'privilege' of visiting Epstein's island.

segments.title: Face Drawing, Rudeness, and Pec Bouncing
segments.notes: Jeb and his deceased father (trapped in a board) tutorialize drawing a face, being rude, and bouncing pecs; Jeb fails at pec control but succeeds at flexing his glutes until near-syncope.

segments.title: Viewer News Roundup: Celsius Recall, ICP AI, Viewbotting, Adult Camp, Spaghetti Drink
segments.notes: Case and Chet process chat-submitted stories: mislabeled vodka seltzers, Kamala Harris skipping California governor run, ICP AI video, ChetAI/Maya refusal to rap, Twitch viewbotting claims, Gilbert Arenas poker arrest, LGBTQ adult summer camp, Spaghetti (beer-Aperol) drink trend, penis-graffiti feminist campaign, US rights watchlist, YouTube profanity policy rollback, radioactive wasps, robot guitarist, Chatterbait moderator lawsuit, snake catcher, RFK Jr mental health cuts.

segments.title: Hell Debate: Toilet Paper Beard vs Mullet
segments.notes: Munch debates the Devil and a husk Crum in hell over toilet paper orientation; Munch wins by interrupting with a Battle of Warsaw factoid; Devil threatens to keep Crum unless Munch concedes.

segments.title: Park Opinions: Call of Duty Claimer, Soccer Frog, Putin, Devil, Squirrel King, Eleanor Rigby, Mountain Man Mike, HOA, Poker Max
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews a surreal parade of park denizens including a fake Putin, the Devil soliciting a side deal for Crum, a squirrel king with testicle-tangled subjects, the real Eleanor Rigby, an HOA president complaining about underwear washing, and a poker-playing friend named Max.

segments.title: Lie Detector Panel: Long Thread in Pocket
segments.notes: Case runs a confused lie-detector game with Chris, Little Tommy Biglaw, Grandma Crumble Bottom, and Pepito; Pepito immediately admits to having the thread, Grandman claims 'euphemism for penis' on birth certificate, Chris reveals an uncomfortably long flaccid penis, chat votes Little Tommy as the liar.
